Subject: Aurora Retail — vendor paperwork inventory & PO path (DPA / SOC 2 / subprocessors)

Hi Neha / Ben / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — we want to move forward with Redwood for inference serving for several teams. Procurement asked me to gather the security and contracting artifacts so we can start the PO and legal gate. Can you share the following so I can send them to our procurement team this afternoon?

- Executed DPA or a DocuSign link we can sign
- Current SOC 2 report (or link to hosted summary) + date of last audit
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred) and any outstanding subprocessor exceptions policy
- Invoicing / PO routing instructions (billing contact, remit address, invoicing cadence)

If you have a standard procurement checklist for activation (what typically blocks PO creation), please attach. We are aiming to finish internal review by EOD Friday and want to ensure we route the PO correctly to avoid delays.

Thanks — I can take the DocuSign flow if you send the link.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement
Aurora Retail
oliver.grant@auroraretail.com
+1 415-555-0162

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Retail — vendor paperwork inventory & PO path (DPA / SOC 2 / subprocessors)

Hi Oliver — appreciate the clear list. See items below and a couple of clarifying asks.

1) DPA: I attached our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.0.pdf). We prefer DocuSign for execution; here's our signing link (DocuSign: https://app.redwood.example/docusign/AR-DPA-2026). If you prefer track changes, let me know the requested redlines and we can loop Legal.

2) SOC 2: We host a read-only summary for SOC 2 Type II and a portal for secure access to the full report. Public summary link: https://soc2.redwood.example/summary-2025. If procurement needs the full report we can grant temporary access; tell me the reviewer email list. Last audit completed: Apr 2026.

3) Subprocessors: attached CSV (subprocessors_inventory_20260630.csv) with vendor name, purpose, location, and data access scope. We maintain an exceptions process — if Aurora has a blocker for any listed subprocessor, flag it and include justification and desired mitigation.

4) PO / Billing: For PO creation, route to billing@redwood.example. Remit details and invoicing cadence are in the DPA appendix (page 5). Typical cadence: monthly in arrears by default; we can support net-30 or net-45 on contract. If Aurora requires a purchase order number before DocuSign, confirm the PO number and billing contact and we'll route acceptance internally.

A few asks from our side to speed this up:
- Please confirm the list of reviewers who need access to the full SOC 2 (names + emails).
- Let us know if Aurora requires a separate SLA or uptime addendum for the Dedicated deployment lane — that can change procurement terms.

I'll copy Procurement and Legal internally; Ben is on invoicing and Karthik handles subprocessor escalations.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.example
+1 650-555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.0.pdf (PDF, 124KB), subprocessors_inventory_20260630.csv (CSV, 8KB)
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@auroraretail.com>

Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@auroraretail.com>, procure@auroraretail.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Retail — vendor paperwork inventory & PO path (DPA / SOC 2 / subprocessors)

Thanks Neha — that's very helpful. A few quick clarifications from Procurement:

- We will sign via DocuSign; please confirm the signatory name on your side and whether countersignature is required from Redwood before we finalize the PO.
- Procurement needs the billing remit address in plain text to put on the PO (we couldn't find the remit lines in the DPA appendix PDF preview). Can you paste remit info in your reply?
- One of our security reviewers, Jason Park (jason.park@auroraretail.com), will need access to the full SOC 2 report. Please provision temporary access to the secure portal for jason.park@auroraretail.com and security-review@auroraretail.com.
- Regarding subprocessors: we saw one EU-hosted analytics provider in the CSV that requires an additional data processing addendum for our legal team. Can Karthik share the subprocessors' data flow diagram or an architecture note for that vendor?

On timing: we want the PO on July 6th. If the DPA is signable this week and the SOC 2 access is provisioned by tomorrow evening, we should be able to keep that date.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Procurement Manager
Aurora Retail
